packs.title: Godot node icons
packs.author: pixel-boy
notes: Six variants: color, control, node, node_2D, node_3D, and white.
648 icons are 16x16; the five icon_reset_2.png variants are 10x12.
Useful for HUD buttons, status icons, build tools, save/pause, zoom, health, and resources.
Originally designed for Godot editor nodes; the pack is a UI icon library rather than a complete map tileset.

packs.title: Keyboard and controller keys (new)
packs.author: Hyohnoo
notes: Four 256x256 keyboard sheets in black/white and alternative font styles.
Three 320x320 controller sheets: PS4, Xbox 360, and Xbox One.
Individual key graphics vary from 16x16 to 64x16; sheets are not a uniform one-icon-per-cell atlas.
Best suited to graphical tutorial and keyboard-control prompts.

packs.title: Keyboard and controller keys (legacy)
packs.author: Hyohnoo
notes: Two 256x256 sheets: Keyboard Buttons and Xbox Buttons.
A distinct older release; retained separately from the newer download.

packs.title: Urizen tilesets
packs.author: vurmux
notes: Main atlas: 2679x651 pixels. Publisher describes over 5500 12x12 tiles across multiple themes.
Main atlas uses a 13-pixel grid: 12x12 tiles, one-pixel gutters, one-pixel initial margin; 206 columns and 50 rows.
Four 12-pixel-wide magenta guide bands occupy zero-based tile columns 25, 51, 77, and 103; exclude these when choosing sprites.
Contains terrain, doors, walls, furniture, items, machinery, sci-fi equipment, characters, symbols, and bitmap lettering.
Free 2-bit sample: 261x92 pixels, on the same 12x12 / 13-pixel pitch layout; 20 columns and 7 rows.
Both are full-color RGBA PNG atlases. The 1-bit and 2-bit names describe the art style, not the PNG bit depth.
Strongest source for a future graphical Regolith map; the two-bit file is a limited showcase.

suggested_regolith_usage.map_grid: 12x12 tiles; start at (1,1), advance 13 pixels per column/row

catalog_scope: Game-independent artwork descriptions, subjects, type, composition and measured colors for every region. Current Ithica and retained preview usage remain separate projections; original source identity and evidence are preserved.

catalog_limits: Every crop has generic artwork metadata and measured foreground colors; uncertain visual subjects remain explicitly uncertain.
Generic asset descriptions are independent of game-specific usage and proposals. Authoring coverage and visual observation scope are recorded explicitly.
Historical exact-RGB matches and filename/control labels retain their original evidence. Uncertain figures and fragments remain uncertain.
No inferred animation timing, direction set, species, collision mask, or autotile bitmask is presented as publisher metadata.
Renderer registration in the viewer is separate from active gameplay use. Unbound sprites remain unused even though the viewer can display them.

notes: All sockets, collision, fuel, weights and biome roles are authored game rules, not publisher metadata.
Room sockets are north/east/south/west; 0=sealed masonry, 1=centered one-cell arch. Adjacent chunks must agree.
Original artwork, IDs and rectangles are unchanged.

ithica_casting.scope: Current Ithica lunar bindings, distinct from retained RPG preview selections. Original source IDs, crops and identity confidence remain unchanged.

grit.limits: CA terrain; explicit walkability. Author grit reused as lunar dust.

rock-floor.limits: CA terrain variation. No inferred terrain animation.

flagstone.limits: WFC room floors; an observed constructed surface, with no claimed origin.

cracked-wall.limits: WFC structural boundary. Collision and sockets come from code.

boulder.limits: Ground.Wall in Ithica; the legacy preview also uses this crop as nonblocking scenery.

stairs-up.limits: A readable exit marker. Travel has an explicit time cost.

resident.limits: Reuses the exact colony engineer crop. Profession, suit protection and field role are game data, not publisher identity.

bandit.limits: An uncertain humanoid silhouette. No faction, species, origin or animation is claimed.

wisp.limits: An uncertain effect-like silhouette. Distinct intent and stats; no supernatural explanation is asserted.

crystal.limits: A readable salvage marker. Recovery yields actual carried stock, deposited only on return.

well.limits: An equipment-like marker requiring a paid repair. Original source identity is retained separately.

gate.limits: Blocking object until a restored pump permits cycling the seal; global route validation prevents bypass.

gate-open.limits: Same source mapping as the preview; switches presentation after the seal is opened.

hazard-corruption.limits: The publisher leaf motif is a symbolic overlay, not a claim of lunar plants. Only eligible unprotected cells spread it; no outdoor ordinary fire.

ithica_casting.legacy_rules: generation_rules and usage.rpg retain preview/intermediate-generation meaning; use sprites[].ithica for the current game.

asset_taxonomy.foreground_rule: Alpha zero and RGB channels all <=8 are background for measurement, without changing source pixels.
asset_taxonomy.identity_rule: Publisher identity, visual subject claims and gameplay casting are independent. Each subject claim records confidence, basis and evidence.
asset_taxonomy.composition_rule: Fragments, variant groups and suggested layers do not supply animation, directions, collision or adjacency rules.

reference_images.scope: Derived preview composites and documentation screenshots, retained as reference images rather than independent source sprites. Paths are repository-relative. Original sprite images and crop identities remain in the canonical source inventory.
